TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR

title: Pony | Unicorn Hair Colour
description: Pony - Semi-Permanent Fantasy Hair Colour Introducing Unicorn Hair, hyper-performance hair colour from Lime Crime that leaves hair feeling silky smooth and smelling like a meadow! Colour: Electric Violet-Purple Weight:  6.76 fl oz / 200 mL 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free HOW TO USE: Apply to pre-bleached, clean, unconditioned hair. Massage colour into each strand. For longer-lasting, more intense results, leave the dye in for 1-2 hours. For more pastel results, wash out after 30 minutes. Don’t worry, Unicorn Hair will not damage your hair, as it does not contain any harsh chemicals or bleach! Rinse until water runs clear, shampoo & condition as usual. To extend the life of your colour, use shampoo for colour-treated hair in between colourings. Caution:  This product is not intended for use anywhere on the face or in the immediate eye area, it must not be used to dye the eyelashes or eyebrows, to do so may cause harm to the eyes. Always protect your clothing and workspace prior to application; wear gloves. Perform a preliminary patch test, as Unicorn Hair contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. You can use a cotton swab to apply a tiny amount of Unicorn Hair to the skin (usually on the nape of the neck or near the elbow). Wait 24 hours and be alert for any signs of redness or irritation. If any irritation presents discontinue use immediately. Unicorn Hair is ready to use. Do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colourant. Unicorn Hair may temporarily stain skin and will permanently stain fabric. Keep out of reach of children. LIME CRIME

title: Vivids Pink | Hair Colour
description: Vivids Pink | HAIR COLOUR One of the fastest growing and innovative colour brands brings us long-lasting, intense hair colour that does not transfer onto other strands or into other colours. Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form. Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml Dimensions : 5 x 3 x 20 cm PRAVANA CHROMASILK

Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form.   Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml Dimensions : 5 x 3 x 20 cm PRAVANA CHROMASILK

title: Juicy | Unicorn Hair Colour
description: Juicy - Semi-Permanent Fantasy Hair Colour Lime Crime's Unicorn Hair is hyper-performance hair colour that leaves hair feeling silky-smooth and smelling like a meadow!  Colour: Fuchsia - Full Coverage Weight:  6.76 fl oz / 200 mL 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free HOW TO USE: Apply to pre-bleached, clean, unconditioned hair. Massage colour into each strand. For longer-lasting, more intense results, leave the dye in for 1-2 hours. For more pastel results, wash out after 30 minutes. Don’t worry, Unicorn Hair will not damage your hair, as it does not contain any harsh chemicals or bleach! Rinse until water runs clear, shampoo & condition as usual. To extend the life of your colour, use shampoo for colour-treated hair in between colourings. Caution:  This product is not intended for use anywhere on the face or in the immediate eye area, it must not be used to dye the eyelashes or eyebrows, to do so may cause harm to the eyes. Always protect your clothing and workspace prior to application; wear gloves. Perform a preliminary patch test, as Unicorn Hair contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. You can use a cotton swab to apply a tiny amount of Unicorn Hair to the skin (usually on the nape of the neck or near the elbow). Wait 24 hours and be alert for any signs of redness or irritation. If any irritation presents discontinue use immediately. Unicorn Hair is ready to use. Do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colourant. Unicorn Hair may temporarily stain skin and will permanently stain fabric. Keep out of reach of children. LIME CRIME

title: Natural Black | Hair Colour
description: Natural Black Hair Colour Crazy Colour Semi-permanent bright & bold hair colour! Crazy Color Natural Black is a brown/black perfect for covering naturally dark hair or creating a shadow root. Can be used over hair that's already dark right up to lightest blondes. 100% Vegan and Cruelty Free! To get the best result from your Crazy Color hair dye we recommend you use it on pre-lightened hair, but it can also be used as a tint on natural hair. This dye is a semi-permanent colour which means it will fade with every wash, but should last approx 4-8 washes depending on hair condition & type. WEIGHT:  100ml INSTRUCTIONS : - Strand & sensitivity tests are always recommended before any sort of dye is applied. - Shampoo your hair with a PH neutral shampoo, don't use conditioner, towel dry your hair. - Apply Crazy Color directly while hair is still damp, spreading evenly over the hair (wear gloves). - Leave for 15/30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly until water runs clear. TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR

title: Toxic Uv | Hair Colour
description: DON'T YOU KNOW THAT YOU'RE TOXIC. Crazy Colour Semi-permanent bright & bold hair colour! It's NEON - Introducing TOXIC UV, This ultra glowing green is not for the faint-hearted. Make em' stop and stare, with a shade that pop's in both natural and blacklight.   For best results apply to pale or platinum blonde hair. 100% Vegan and Cruelty Free! To get the best result from your Crazy Color hair dye we recommend you use it on pre-lightened hair, but it can also be used as a tint on natural hair. This dye is a semi-permanent colour which means it will fade with every wash, but should last approx 4-8 washes depending on hair condition & type. WEIGHT:  100ml INSTRUCTIONS : - Strand & sensitivity tests are always recommended before any sort of dye is applied. - Shampoo your hair with a PH neutral shampoo, don't use conditioner, towel dry your hair. - Apply Crazy Color directly while hair is still damp, spreading evenly over the hair (wear gloves). - Leave for 15/30 minutes, then rinse thoroughly until water runs clear. TIPS : - Avoid dandruff or harsh shampoos. These can strip colour like there is no tomorrow! - Use a sulphate free or color friendly shampoo & wash as little as possible. Colour will be lost after each wash so avoid over-washing! - Rinse hair with cold water, post shampooing. It closes the hair cuticles and seals in maximum colour. - Too much direct sunlight will strip all that edgy Crazy Color right out. - Avoid swimming. Chlorine is another nasty product that will strip the life and color from your lovely hair. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  CRAZY COLOR Shop all Hair Colour Shop all  Crazy Colour

title: Vivids Violet | Hair Colour
description: One of the fastest growing and innovative colour brands brings us long-lasting, intense hair colour that does not transfer onto other strands or into other colours. Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form. Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml Dimensions : 5 x 3 x 20 cm PRAVANA CHROMASILK

title: Twisted Thorn | Plug Hoop Earrings
description: Every rose has its thorn. 20g Surgical Steel Twisted Thorn plug-friendly hoop earrings. These plug hoops are designed to fit comfortably in any flesh tunnel style of body jewellery worn in the earlobe, and they can be worn as a normal earrings too! Sold as a Pair. SIZE:  5cm diameter. 0.8mm gauge. MATERIAL: 316L Steel Post / Z inc Alloy Thorns 316L Steel: 316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. BODYVIBE

description: She wandered into the forest, and never returned... The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. BODYVIBE

title: Vivids Blue Topaz | Hair Colour
description: One of the fastest growing and innovative colour brands brings us long-lasting, intense hair colour that does not transfer onto other strands or into other colours. Amongst the longest-lasting unnatural hair colours, Pravana's Chromasilk Vivids range delivers bright, rich semi-permanent shades in a conditioning form. MIXING/CUSTOMISING COLOURS: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. FEATURES: Paraben-Free Zero Phthalates No animal testing Free from MEA and DEA EPA and CARB compliant DIRECTIONS: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. VOLUME: 90ml PRAVANA CHROMASILK

title: Genie | Unicorn Hair Colour
description: Lime Crime's Unicorn Hair is hyper-performance hair colour that leaves hair feeling silky-smooth and smelling like a meadow! Colour: Deep violet-purple Weight:  6.76 fl oz / 200 mL 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free HOW TO USE: Apply to pre-bleached, clean, unconditioned hair. Massage colour into each strand. For longer-lasting, more intense results, leave the dye in for 1-2 hours. For more pastel results, wash out after 30 minutes. Don’t worry, Unicorn Hair will not damage your hair, as it does not contain any harsh chemicals or bleach! Rinse until water runs clear, shampoo & condition as usual. To extend the life of your colour, use shampoo for colour-treated hair in between colourings. Caution:  This product is not intended for use anywhere on the face or in the immediate eye area, it must not be used to dye the eyelashes or eyebrows, to do so may cause harm to the eyes. Always protect your clothing and workspace prior to application; wear gloves. Perform a preliminary patch test, as Unicorn Hair contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. You can use a cotton swab to apply a tiny amount of Unicorn Hair to the skin (usually on the nape of the neck or near the elbow). Wait 24 hours and be alert for any signs of redness or irritation. If any irritation presents discontinue use immediately. Unicorn Hair is ready to use. Do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colourant. Unicorn Hair may temporarily stain skin and will permanently stain fabric. Keep out of reach of children. LIME CRIME

title: Flash Lightning | Bleach Kit [30 Vol]
description: GUILT-FREE GLAMOUR! Before using any Manic Panic Semi-Permanent Hair Color, pre-lighten your hair with Flash Lightning Bleach to get the most intense color. This kit comes complete with:   1 dust-free bleach powder   1 30-volume cream developer   1 mixing tub   1 tint brush   1 plastic cap   1 set of plastic gloves   and instructions for use. INSTRUCTIONS:  The MANIC PANIC FLASH LIGHTNING bleach kit was designed for pre-lightening hair before using MANIC PANIC vegan semi-permanent hair colors. Everything you need to lighten your hair is in this kit. Please follow the instructions carefully. We strongly recommend doing a strand test prior to application. (Take one strand of hair and follow instructions.)   PREPARATIONS:  1. Wearing the enclosed gloves, open the bleach plastic bag. Avoid inhaling powder.   2.   Empty the full contents of the bleach powder   into the plastic tub provided.   3.   Add the full contents of the developer to the bleach powder   in the plastic tub. Using the provided brush, blend until   all   the powder is completely dissolved with no lumps. Mix and blend until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Let stand one minute. The mixture will thicken.   4. Apply the mixture to the hair avoiding direct contact with the scalp.   *   It is important to use all the developer and mix using only the brush provided. Do not use any metal instruments.   APPLICATION: Hair should be dry and unwashed. Using the provided brush, apply the bleach mixture evenly to hair you wish bleached. All strands should be saturated using the brush or gloved fingers to spread the mixture evenly. You may mask hair you don’t wish to bleach by using a highlight cap or foil. DEVELOPING:  Use of enclosed plastic cap is recommended through the developing process. The length of the timing depends on the color and condition of the hair. Check hair at regular intervals during the development process as timing varies according to the degree of desired lightening.

title: Flash Lightning | Bleach Kit [40 Vol]
description: Before using any Manic Panic Semi-Permanent Hair Color, pre-lighten your hair with Flash Lightning Bleach to get the most intense color.  One Bleaching Kit is enough product for short hair of average thickness up to 4 inches in length. Multiple kits will be required for longer hair - about one kit for every 4-5 inches of hair length. This kit comes complete with:  1 dust-free bleach powder 1 40-volume cream developer 1 mixing tub 1 tint brush 1 plastic cap 1 set of plastic gloves and instructions for use. 1.3 oz of powder, 4 oz of developer INSTRUCTIONS: The MANIC PANIC/FLASH LIGHTNING bleach kit was designed for pre-lightening hair before using MANIC PANIC vegan semi-permanent hair colors. Everything you need to lighten your hair is in this kit. Please follow the instructions carefully. We strongly recommend doing a strand test prior to application. (Take one strand of hair and follow instructions.) PREPARATIONS: 1. Wearing the enclosed gloves, open the bleach plastic bag. Avoid inhaling powder. 2.  Empty the full contents of the bleach powder  into the plastic tub provided. 3.  Add the full contents of the developer to the bleach powder  in the plastic tub. Using the provided brush, blend until  all  the powder is completely dissolved with no lumps. Mix and blend until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Let stand one minute. The mixture will thicken. 4. Apply the mixture to the hair avoiding direct contact with the scalp. *  It is important to use all the developer and mix using only the brush provided. Do not use any metal instruments. APPLICATION: Hair should be dry and unwashed. Using the provided brush, apply the bleach mixture evenly to hair you wish bleached. All strands should be saturated using the brush or gloved fingers to spread the mixture evenly. You may mask hair you don’t wish to bleach by using a highlight cap or foil. DEVELOPING:

title: Vivids Orange | Hair Colour
description: ChromaSilk VIVIDS gives hair artists everything they need to concoct, mix and create endless colour palettes. Unleash your artistry. Mixing/Customising Colours: Vivids Locked-In can be intermixed to create any colour imaginable. Due to the special pigments used, Locked-In colours need to be mixed thoroughly in the bowl. Mix the colours together until you see that there is no separation of the colours and a uniform colour is achieved. To lighten or pastel any of the Vivids Locked-In colours, use Pravana’s Vivids Clear. Add Vivids Locked-In colour of your choice to Vivids Clear until the colour desired is achieved. Vivids Locked-In may be intermixed with the other Vivids Collection colours, but the colour created may transfer. Features: – Paraben-Free – Zero Phthalates – No animal testing – Free from MEA and DEA – EPA and CARB compliant Directions: 1. Pre-lighten hair using PRAVANA Pure Light Power Lightener to the desired level. For purity of Locked-In colour, follow the chart provided and pre-lighten hair to the level indicated for each shade. If hair is lightened beyond the recommended guideline, colour transfer may occur. 2. Before applying Locked-In, hair must be freshly shampooed and completely dried. 3. Taking a sections apply colour directly to the hair, applying section-by-section to ensure complete and even coverage. No developer is needed. 4. Allow to process for 20-30 minutes at room temperature. Once the processing is complete, lightly shampoo with Vivids Colour Protect and rinse with cool water until the water runs clear. Apply Vivids Colour Protect Conditioner and rinse. Style as desired. *When lifting hair more than 3 levels we recommend performing a Silk Degrees Treatment after the lightening process, but before the Vivids Application. Volume : 90ml PRAVANA CHROMASILK

description: The quick, easy and healthy way to remove colour from your hair! Bleach Free. Ammonia Free. With Argan oil. Zalon Pro Colour Remover Kit is a 3-step system that removes all types of oxidised hair colour by reversing the process and shrinking the colour out of the hair. Directions: 1. title: Glam Goth Coffin | Plug Hoop Earrings
description: Black Plated Cut Out Coffin with Chains & Cross Plug Hoops. These plug hoops are designed to fit comfortably in any flesh tunnel style of body jewellery worn in the earlobe, and they can be worn as a normal earrings too! Sold as a Pair. Size:   0.8mm Material:   Black PVD, 316L Steel 316L Steel: 316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. Black PVD Steel: Black PVD (Physical Vapour Deposition) involves a coating applied onto SS316L body jewellery. In order to create the black look, the jewellery is placed in a heated, high vacuum chamber, where electric voltage is applied. This process creates gases that produce ions, which are bonded to the jewellery. When the process is completed, the jewellery will have a hard layer that is both biocompatible and can be autoclaved. Black steel PVD should only be worn in fully healed piercings. The finish can come in either high polish or matte. BODYVIBE Shop all  Cross Earrings

title: Arrow Point [Septum] | Clicker
description: Arrow Point Septum Clicker. Made from Surgical Steel. Great for Daith Piercings and Fully Autoclavable. Size: 16g 3/8" x 5/16" Material:   316L Steel 316L Steel: 316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. BODYVIBE

title: Matte Black | Underbust Corset, 18"
description: This beautiful Matte Black Corset is a curved underbust style, suitable for tight lacing and will fit most types of silhouettes. This corset features spiral steel bones, which fit perfectly to the body and provide comfort. They do not deform even after a long period of use. On the back, there are flat steel bones, which provide support to the grommets. Because of these, the corset stays in place. Features: Curved Style Underbust Corset Spiral Steel Bones 100% Cotton Lining Black Mesh Style How to choose the right size Corset? Measure your actual waist at its narrowest point minus 4-7 inches from it. Subtract level depends on how much compression you want, how squishy vs firm and your experience level. You should also pay attention to the size under the bust and upper hip. These measurements should be close to your actual size. This prevents the pressure on the ribs and hip bones. If a corset is well fitted it should never reach the point where you experience pain, or be so tight that you cannot breathe properly. A new corset should be laced a bit loosely. Both the body and the corset must adjust to the systematic pressure, so don't force the corset too quickly as it may break. It's best to wear a corset a couple of hours per day so it will adapt to your body properly. After a while, the gap on the back of the corset should be reduced to the minimum and you should break in the corset perfectly. Please note: Corsets that are shaped closely to your body's natural shape will season faster than one that is not. Measurements: These authentic steel boned corsets are determined by waist size in inches. title: Black Brocade | Underbust Corset, 18"
description: This beautiful Black Brocade Corset is a curved underbust style, suitable for tight lacing and will fit most types of silhouettes. This corset features spiral steel bones, which fit perfectly to the body and provide comfort. They do not deform even after a long period of use. On the back, there are flat steel bones, which provide support to the grommets. Because of these, the corset stays in place. Features: Curved Style Underbust Corset 18 Spiral Steel Bones Waist Tape 100% Cotton Lining Black Mesh Style How to choose the right size Corset? Measure your actual waist at its narrowest point minus 4-7 inches from it. Subtract level depends on how much compression you want, how squishy vs firm and your experience level. You should also pay attention to the size under the bust and upper hip. These measurements should be close to your actual size. This prevents the pressure on the ribs and hip bones. If a corset is well fitted it should never reach the point where you experience pain, or be so tight that you cannot breathe properly. A new corset should be laced a bit loosely. Both the body and the corset must adjust to the systematic pressure, so don't force the corset too quickly as it may break. It's best to wear a corset a couple of hours per day so it will adapt to your body properly. After a while, the gap on the back of the corset should be reduced to the minimum and you should break in the corset perfectly. Please note:   Corsets that are shaped closely to your body's natural shape will season faster than one that is not. Measurements:   These authentic steel boned corsets are determined by waist size in inches. title: Black Brocade | Underbust Corset, 32"
description: This beautiful Black Brocade Corset is a curved underbust style, suitable for tight lacing and will fit most types of silhouettes. This corset features spiral steel bones, which fit perfectly to the body and provide comfort. They do not deform even after a long period of use. On the back, there are flat steel bones, which provide support to the grommets. Because of these, the corset stays in place. Features: Curved Style Underbust Corset 18 Spiral Steel Bones Waist Tape 100% Cotton Lining Black Mesh Style How to choose the right size Corset? Measure your actual waist at its narrowest point minus 4-7 inches from it. Subtract level depends on how much compression you want, how squishy vs firm and your experience level. You should also pay attention to the size under the bust and upper hip. These measurements should be close to your actual size. This prevents the pressure on the ribs and hip bones. If a corset is well fitted it should never reach the point where you experience pain, or be so tight that you cannot breathe properly. A new corset should be laced a bit loosely. Both the body and the corset must adjust to the systematic pressure, so don't force the corset too quickly as it may break. It's best to wear a corset a couple of hours per day so it will adapt to your body properly. After a while, the gap on the back of the corset should be reduced to the minimum and you should break in the corset perfectly. Please note:   Corsets that are shaped closely to your body's natural shape will season faster than one that is not. title: Deluxe Custom Fangs | REFILL KIT
description: This Scarecrow Deluxe Custom Fangs Refill Kit is perfect if you require more mould to re-customise your fangs!  - Refit your fangs - Easy to use - Four capsules and mixing liquid - Works on Scarecrow Deluxe Custom Fangs How to use: Open capsules into mixing container provided and squirt four drops of liquid into the container. Mix with a stirring stick until the solution thickens. Use the stick to scoop out the solution and apply to the inside of the fang. Place fang over canines, incisors or bottom teeth and wait five minutes. Repeat the previous step on the second fang, and wait 15 minutes to allow the mould to set. After moulding, your fangs can be reused by simply snapping them back in! How can I remove the old mould before customising again? You can pry the old moulding material out of the fang caps with tweezers. It may help to put the fangs in really hot water for a few minutes then look for any areas of where the mould may be loose from the fang cap. You can try pinching the front and back of the tooth cap together to help the separation along. Then, try using tweezers or needle nose pliers to grab any loose edges and pull it out. title: Vegvisir Raven Skull | Plug Hoop Earrings
description: These badass Vegvisir Raven Skull plug-friendly hoops have surgical steel posts and not only have an awesomely detailed hanging Raven Skull, they're also framed with a rope chain and feature an I celandic magical stave carved into the skulls ! All hail these original plug hoop earrings...perfect for everyday wear- if you dare. Which we know you will! Sold as a pair. SIZE:   Length - 10cm x Width - 6.35cm (3.9" x 2.5")  Material:  20g Silver Plated 316L Steel 316L Steel: 316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. BODYVIBE Shop all  Skull Earrings

SIZE:  Length - 9.5cm x Width - 3.2cm (3.74" x 1.25") Material:  316L Steel 316L Steel: 316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. BODYVIBE

title: Sour Candy | Unicorn Hair Colour
description: Semi-Permanent Fantasy Hair Colour - True Bright Pink Dyed and gone to Unicorn Heaven! Lime Crime's Full Coverage, ultra-conditioning formula delivers high intensity, magical color results. Vibrant, bold, and darker shades are in the full coverage range. FEATURES:  - Protects and Softens Hair - Delicious Scent! - Full Coverage - Super-Saturated Pigment Delivers intense colour impact on pre-lightened platinum to medium blonde hair and adds a tint of colour to dark blonde and light brown hair. Results may vary depending on the color and condition of hair. WHAT IT DOES:   Turns you into a real-life unicorn! Deep-conditions while depositing color. Long-lasting color that fades gracefully. WHAT IT WON'T DO:   Damage your hair. Ever! HOW IT WORKS:  You'll need:   gloves, applicator brush, clips, bowl, and an old t-shirt or cape. Cover all surfaces you do not want to get hair dye on as Unicorn Hair can permanently stain surfaces and fabric. 1.   Start with clean, unconditioned, dry hair. Full Coverage works best with pre-lightened platinum to pale blonde hair. 2.   Wear protective gloves and pour desired amount into a bowl. 3.   Section hair into 4 even sections (front to back and side to side) and secure with clips. Work in 1 inch wide strands. Apply color evenly from root to tip with applicator brush. Begin at the root of the hair, applying color evenly through to the ends. Massage each strand with fingers, root to tip, to ensure even distribution of color. 4.   Leave for 30 minutes. No heat/cap required. For more intense, longer-lasting results, leave for 1-2 hours. Don't worry, Unicorn Hair will not damage your hair, as it does not contain any harsh chemicals or bleach! 5.   Rinse hair in cool to lukewarm water until hair feels clean. More intense shades may not rinse clear for the first few washes. Do not shampoo. Conditioner optional. 6.   Style to your liking and enjoy your new Unicorn Hair! Weight:  6.76 fl oz / 200 mL 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free! Warning:   Unicorn Hair is ready to use; do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colorant. May temporarily stain skin and permanently stain fabric. Always protect clothing and work space prior to application and wear gloves. Perform a preliminary patch test, as this product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. Use a cotton swab to apply a small amount of product to clean/dry skin, such as on the nape of the neck or near the elbow. Allow patch to dry and leave undisturbed for 24 hours. Monitor area for any signs of redness or irritation; if any irritation occurs, discontinue use. This product is not intended for use anywhere on the face or in the immediate eye area. It must not be used to dye eyelashes or eyebrows, to do so may cause harm to the eyes. Keep out of reach of children. LIME CRIME

title: Batty [Black] | Septum Clicker
description: "You and me could write a Bat Romance.." This Batty Septum Clicker will make your dark heart flutter! Perfect for your Septum, Helix, Daith, Conch, or Lobe piercings. Hinged Segment Clickers are easy to use and snap into place with a satisfying "click". With a hinged prong and minimal seams, Hinged Clickers are perfect for daily wear. Includes: One Clicker Size: 16g 3/8" (1.2mm 10mm) Please Note: These little Battys are super small in person! Please see the third image for size reference. Material:  316L Steel with Black PVD Coating. 316L Steel: 316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. Black PVD Steel: Black PVD (Physical Vapour Deposition) involves a coating applied onto SS316L body jewellery. In order to create the black look, the jewellery is placed in a heated, high vacuum chamber, where electric voltage is applied. This process creates gases that produce ions, which are bonded to the jewellery. When the process is completed, the jewellery will have a hard layer that is both biocompatible and can be autoclaved. Black steel PVD should only be worn in fully healed piercings. The finish can come in either high polish or matte. BODYVIBE

title: Good Dye Young | Hair Lightening Kit
description: The NEW Hair Lightening Kit is exactly what you need to bleach hair to that perfect white canvas so it’s ready to show off some vibrant colour. GDY doubled the size of this kit to give you more value.  They have also changed the formula to be vegan and gluten free! Features: - Lightens the hair and opens the cuticle, to properly receive our ultra vibrant Semi-Permanent pigments - 25 Volume Creme Developer, gentle enough for light brown hair but powerful enough to lighten darker hair as well - Dust-Free Powder Lightener contains Soy Protein to minimize damage from the lightening process - Contains Coconut Oil to help condition the hair - Vegan. Cruelty Free. Gluten Free. Kit Includes: - Dust Free Powder Lightener (1.34 oz.) - 25 Volume Cream Developer (4 oz.) - Coconut Oil to condition hair during the lightening process - Soy Protein protects and strengthens the hair while lightening HOW TO APPLY: Lightening your hair will give the most vibrant results from your GDY Semi-Permanent Dye.  To create the lightening mix, GDY have made it easy for you! Simply mix one bottle of the Creme Developer with one packet of Powder Lightener in a non-metallic bowl to a creamy consistency.  We recommend a strand test before full application Hair should be dry and it’s best if hair is unwashed. 2. Section your hair and apply the lightening mixture with a gloved hand or brush. (TIPS: saturate the hair and cover it when you finish, to keep the Lightener from drying out. When it dries, it stops working. Protect your skin from irritation by applying shea butter, coconut oil or thick hair conditioner to your hairline and over the ears.) 3. Let your hair process for no more than 50 minutes, until you achieve the desired tone. Check consistently (every 5-10 minutes) to evaluate the colour lift. 4. After you achieve the desired result, rinse and shampoo your hair thoroughly with warm water until you are sure all of the product is removed. Do NOT condition the hair, as your Semi-Permanent Dye will act like your conditioner when you apply. 5. Wait at least 24 hours before any further lightening. 6. Before colouring with GDY Semi-Permanent Dye, make sure hair is totally dry. When it is, you’re ready for colour! HOW MANY KITS YOU WILL NEED: This depends on whether you are simply doing a small section of your hair or the entire head. An entire head could require 3-5 Hair Lightening Kits depending on length and thickness. Please Note: We recommend that you patch test any new product before its continued usage. If any redness or itching occurs do not continue use.  GOOD DYE YOUNG

Semi-permanent hair dyes do not damage the hair, in fact they’re super conditioning! GDY’s formula combines a high-quality cream base, like a hair mask with essential oil benefits. title: Born To Raise Hell | Stonedeaf Charity Fitted T-Shirt, LARGE
description: Please Note: Stonedeaf Wildlife is currently taking a break from rescuing. We’re clearing remaining charity stock to make room for new items supporting a different organisation. Profits from this product will be donated to Wet Tropics Wildlife Rescue in the meantime. PLEASE NOTE : This is a FINAL SALE item, sorry NO Returns, Refunds or Exchanges on this item. $15 from ALL t-shirts will go directly to Stonedeaf Wildlife sanctuary who are supporting the rehabilitation of local wildlife based in Townsville. We have decided to partner up with Phil for this collaboration, the founder of Stonedeaf Wildlife, who is a long time friend of Beserk from when he became one of the first stockists of Beserk Clothing almost 15 years ago! With your help, we can make the lives of our wildlife and volunteers at Stonedeaf Wildlife sanctuary a little bit easier.  They provide all wildlife with a sanctuary but have recently become overwhelmed with the amount of orphaned and injured bats coming into care. With $15 from every Beserk for Bats t-shirt going towards Stonedeaf Wildlife, we hope to help take some of the burden off of their shoulders.  Join us today where y our support will help ensure future generations will get to see wildlife in the wild.  ❤️ We believe in the power of the people. With your help, we can continue to raise funds for charities all over Australia. We have raised over $8,000 to date with our most recent fundraiser for the Kawaii Koala T-shirts. We now ask you to hold hands with us while we introduce the Beserk for Bats T-shirts.   STYLE:   Ladies Fitted T-Shirt MATERIALS:  100% soft cotton Keep the black vivid; Wash Cold - Gentle Cycle. title: Amelia Aqua Blue | HAIR COLOUR*
description: Amelia Aqua Blue has arrived, the true Mediterranean sea-inspired blue colour that gives you irresistible aquamarine hair. This semi-permanent hair dye applies and nourishes like a conditioner. For best results, we recommend bleaching your hair to medium or light blonde (level 8) with a Bleach Kit first. You can apply Cynthia Cyclamen straight after to dry, unconditioned hair. In 60-90 minutes you will have intense colour that lasts 8-12 washes. All fun with no commitments! Herman’s Professional is a semi-permanent, direct hair colour, that is conditioner-based, and 100% vegan, and cruelty-free. Beautiful & Fierce hair colours that won’t damage your hair! This formula works gently by deep conditioning your hair while colouring, and will fade out naturally. FEATURES: - Conditioner based, no ammonia - Colour remains about 8-12 weeks, results may vary - 100% Vegan & cruelty-free - Best results with pre-lightened to pale blonde hair - DIY friendly/mixable colours HOW TO:   For best results, start with clean, unconditioned, dry hair. Always do a patch and strand test beforehand.  - Shake the jar well before opening. - Use gloves for protection. - Start applying the hair colour to your roots and move down. You can also use a brush for easy application. The key is to make sure that your hair is fully covered. - Once your hair is fully covered, let the hair colour sit on your hair for 30-40 minutes. The longer you hold it on, the more intense the colour will become -  don't worry, conditioner hair colour will not damage your hair, but deep conditions it. - When the time is up, rinse hair with lukewarm water until the water runs clear. Then apply the protective conditioner. It will help keep your colour looking and feeling radiant, soft, and silky. PLEASE NOTE:   Herman's Amazing is ready to use; do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colour. Can temporarily stain skin and permanently stain fabric. title: Move Mountains | Hair Colour
description: I can almost see it, that dark teal I’m missing. There’s a voice inside my head saying "you better bleach it". It’s the cliiiiiiiiiiimb… to great hair. Colour: Dark Teal Features: - Creamy   Vegan & Cruelty Free   Formula 5 oz tube - Botanically Infused with Natural Sunflower Extract - Ammonia Free, Formaldehyde Free, Peroxide Free, PPD Free - Ultra creamy formula that deeply conditions while depositing colour What does it do? This semi-permanent hair dye line combines salon-grade pigments with a nontoxic, conditioning formula that deposits ultra vibrant colour. Semi-permanent hair dyes do not damage the hair, in fact they’re super conditioning! GDY’s formula combines a high-quality cream base, like a hair mask with essential oil benefits. The colour is deposited on top of the hair shaft and acts like a stain that will fade out over time each time you wash your hair. Colour can last anywhere from 4-6 weeks. What does it smell like? Fragranced with Bergamot essential oil, this semi-permanent dye has a light citrus scent that is mood lifting. Is this for my hair? These semi-permanent dyes will show the truest colour on pre-lightened hair, levels 8-10. We recommend using a Lightening Kit to get the perfect base shade for your colour. What to know? Semi-perm is a thick, conditioning formula, no need to mix with a conditioner. Colour payoff will vary based how much hair is lightened as well as on the porosity of the hair and underlying hair chemistry. We recommend a hair strand test to determine colour payoff. Safe on: All hair textures, pre lightened, chemically treated, keratin treated, and colour treated hair. GOOD DYE YOUNG

title: The Classic | Press On Nails

Sizing:   One size fits most. This kit come with 24-28 nails per box. This is to ensure a custom fit, plus extras in case of a mishap! Press-on nails come in numbered sizes, kind of like shoes. If you have small nail beds, you're in the clear. Using a regular nail file, the edges of the Nailz can be filed down to fit your nail size. description: Jorge Moss the grungy olive green that will give you the deep forest hair colour you have been missing! Hair colour nourishes like a deep conditioner while you colour. Herman’s Professional is a semi-permanent, direct hair colour, that is conditioner-based, and 100% vegan, and cruelty-free. Always do a patch and strand test beforehand.  - Shake the jar well before opening. - Use gloves for protection. - Start applying the hair colour to your roots and move down. You can also use a brush for easy application. The key is to make sure that your hair is fully covered. - Once your hair is fully covered, let the hair colour sit on your hair for 30-40 minutes. The longer you hold it on, the more intense the colour will become -  don't worry, conditioner hair colour will not damage your hair, but deep conditions it. - When the time is up, rinse hair with lukewarm water until the water runs clear. Then apply the protective conditioner. It will help keep your colour looking and feeling radiant, soft, and silky. PLEASE NOTE:   Herman's Amazing is ready to use; do not mix with developers, lighteners, or any permanent hair colour. Can temporarily stain skin and permanently stain fabric. title: Wide Hips [Matte Black] | Underbust Corset, 18"
description: This double boned Wide Hips Underbust Corset will give such a dramatic shape to your body! Perfect for accessorising your fave wardrobe staples or your next Halloween/ costume party! Features:  - 20 spiral bones provide comfort and a comfortable fit  - 4 flat metal bones, which provide additional support - On the front of the corset there is very wide, flat bone with busk. All Restyle curved corsets have waist tape, which serves as protection for the seams. Each corset is lined with 100% cotton lining and the modesty panel (18 cm width) Materials: Made of solid, black cotton. Measurements Measure your actual waist at it's narrowest part, minus 4-7 inches from it (10-17 cm). Substract level depends on how much compression you want, how squishy vs firm and your experience level. Please note: Corset that's shaped closely to your body's natural shape will season faster than one that is not. Size: 20g (0.8mm)|59.63mm (L) x 55.12mm (W) Gem Type: Vitrail Medium Crystal Material: 316L Steel 316L Steel:  316L surgical steel is one of the most common materials used for body piercing in the United States and is considered implant grade It is a man-made material that is made by mixing iron with other metals to achieve greater strength. The alloying process involves melting various metals together, in order to produce a "new" metal. Depending on the specific recipe used, each variety of steel gets a grade designation. It is a strong and durable metal that is very easy to clean, which is important for body piercings - especially new ones. It is also corrosion-resistant so it won’t rust or tarnish. Polishing the steel to a mirror finish results in a protective layer of chromium oxide that helps keep the nickel content trapped inside. There is a risk for people with extreme nickel allergies, in which case, titanium should be used. The number 316 has to do with the recipe of metals used when creating the steel.316L surgical steel is a very high grade of steel. The L designation means that the steel is of a "low carbon" variety, which is also very low in nickel content, making it a safe choice for people with nickel allergies. There are many different grades of surgical steel, but the only body-friendly grades are 316L and 316LVM surgical steel. BODYVIBE

Maintaining: - Allow at least 24 hours before your first shampoo - Wash your hair with cool water to minimize the fading process. description: Mika Mint is the pastel mint green shade that will transport you to a dreamy oasis, giving your hair a refreshing and enchanting transformation. For best results, bleach your hair to level 9-10 blonde with Herman's Amazing Bleach Kit. Hair that is natural, not treated, is healthier and will suffer less from bleach. If your hair is too yellow after bleaching, use No Yellow Shampoo or No Yellow Mask to neutralize the yellow into white. Apply and leave it in for 5 minutes. That is important for green hair colours so the yellowness won't turn the green into bright green. Using: Apply a thick layer of Mika Mint hair dye on dry, unconditioned hair and leave it in for 60 - 90 minutes. Herman's hair colours are conditioner-based, so they nourish your hair like a deep conditioner while you colour. Rinse with lukewarm water and enjoy your intense mint green hair colour, that will last up to 12 washes (results may vary depending on the base and condition of the hair, the duration of the colour and hair care products). Maintaining: - Allow at least 24 hours before your first shampoo - Wash your hair with cool water to minimize the fading process. title: Labyrinth: Ello Worm 1:1 | STATUE*
description: Labyrinth (1986) - Ello Worm 1:1 Statue Life-Size Statue Weta Workshop are thrilled to be exploring another world from the mind of Jim Henson, this time bringing you high-quality collectibles from the iconic 1986 film Labyrinth . A careless wish sees a young girl’s baby brother taken away by the mystical Goblin King. With just 13 hours on the clock, sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve, navigate, and survive the many trials and riddles of the mysterious Labyrinth. A single worm, small enough to fit in the palm of one’s hand, with three tufts of dark blue hair rests near a small hole in the Labyrinth’s walls. After offering a moment of brief respite to our young heroine and a promise of hospitality that is rarely shared among strangers, this inconspicuous creature reveals one of the Labyrinth’s many hidden secrets, opening Sarah’s eyes to the first of many illusions to come. This 1:1 scale mixed media statue is ready to aid your collection. Wrapped in his signature red scarf, his untamed synthetic faux fur sticking wildly out, the Worm has been captured in incredible life-like detail. Digitally sculpted by Kim Beaton, this curious statue has been cast in polystone and hand-painted to deliver the highest quality of replication and rests upon a Labyrinthine base sculpted by Shaun Bolton. Size: 7.5 cm x 11 cm x 5 cm Officially Licensed Product

title: Dark Altar | HALTERNECK TOP*, 2X-LARGE
description: Have you ever dared to let the shadows of your soul unfurl? Introducing Restyle's Dark Altar Halterneck Top, an enigmatic creation for the bold and dark-hearted. It is crafted with love and great attention to details! Forever-inspired by the gothic mystery and cathedral patterns, Restyle created this stunning velvet cold-shoulder halterneck. Adorned with ruffles and a peplum waist, this piece exudes regal elegance! Needless to say that the mesh panel with the cathedral spires drawing is like the most beautiful gothic badge that you can proudly wear on your chest! Create a stunning dark lady outfit with Restyle's Crypt Velvet Midi Skirt, they’re made for each other! Features: Gothic halterneck top made from a stretchy luxurious velvet Transparent mesh panel boasts a flock print of our iconic inverted cathedral pattern, creating illusion of a plunge neckline Fitted shape accentuates your silhouette Peplum waist with a flare hem creates a 'fit and flare' silhouette, artfully exaggerating your curves Captivating collar detail seamlessly leads to cold-shoulder design Ruffle cuffs grace the 3/4 sleeves, adding a touch of drama Darts to the side seams ensure a tailored bust fit Concealed zip in side seam for ease of wear. Snap fastening to back collar with two snaps for adjustable sizing ensures secure, personalized fit. title: Rigid Collodion | SCARRING LIQUID

Step 2 : Use coconut oil (or Vaseline) around hairline and on ears to prevent staining of the skin (optional). Step 3 : Wear protective gloves for application. Step 4: Apply colour evenly with colour brush. Begin at the root of the hair and work it evenly through to the ends. Start in the neck and work upwards through the head and be sure to completely saturate the hair shaft. Step 5 : Leave colour on for at least 30 minutes or more. Attitude Hair Dye Colours will NOT damage your hair and has added conditioner, so leaving it on for longer will not hurt a thing. Step 6: Rinse hair, until the water runs clear. title: Adolere | MINI DRESS*, X-SMALL
description: Embrace the dark elegance of gothic romance with Restyle’s Adolere Mini Dress, a masterpiece that perfectly captures the allure of cathedral architecture and witchy mystique. Crafted for those who adore intricate designs, this dress brings an enchanting aura to any wardrobe! The sheer mesh panel at the chest showcases a Cathedral Tracery flock print, offering a glimpse of Gothic grandeur. This dress stands out with its asymmetric hanky hem, creating a mesmerising silhouette. The long, flared sleeves flare out dramatically with a witchy, pointed shape, while cold shoulder cutouts and a halter neck collar add a modern touch to this timeless design. Designed with both comfort and style in mind, the gathered, fitted front waist flatters your figure, while the elastic back waist ensures ease of wear. The fitted bodice and flared skirt highlight feminine shapes, making it a perfect blend of structure and flow. A concealed zip at the back and a delicate button and loop fastening at the neck complete the dress’s elegant construction. Made from a cotton-based fabric with a soft stretch and subtle texture, this gothic black mini dress transforms every gaze into a gesture of adoration. Whether you’re wandering the halls of a cathedral or casting spells under the moonlight, the Adolere Mini Dress is not just designed to be loved—it’s destined to dazzle, elevating your style from dark to divine. title: Oracle of Heaven & Hell | CARD DECK
description: Angels vs demons, demons vs angels: there can be no light without darkness and no darkness without light. This unique oracle of 72 cards combines both infernal and divine powers, with each card containing the image of one goetic demon and the Kabbalistic angel that rules over that demon. In addition to the drawings of the spirits, their summoning sigils are shown behind them. For ease of reading the astrological meaning of each spirit is printed on the card. Oracle of Heaven and Hell can function much like any standard tarot or oracle deck, however, each card provides both a positive and a negative meaning. These should not be seen as either good or bad but rather as two sides of the same coin or, to borrow from Eastern symbology, as the concept of yin and yang or two parts that comprise a whole! title: Stain Eraser | SKIN PROTECTOR KIT*
description: Keep the yuck away! Punky Colour's Stain Eraser Skin Protector Kit. Keeps you sparkly, fresh, and always ready to go after a bangin' hair colour sesh. No stain, no problem! Hair colour stays in your head. Definitely a must-have for all you colour lovers out there. Order now and let your imagination run wild and free! Complete Skin Protection: No limits! Go all in with Punky Colour's Stain Eraser Protector Kit. Hey, wayward splash and splatter is really part of any artistic expression. This kit gives you the freedom to do your thing without worrying about pesky, stubborn stains around your hairline, ears, and neck. We got you covered! Unleash Your Beauty: You deserve only the best! This 2-piece Punky Colour Stain Eraser Protector Kit includes the Pre-Dry Skin Protector and Post-Dye Stain Remover. Made with skin-loving active ingredients and super wholesome natural essences. Stay fresh and clean with glowing skin! No harsh elements, vegan-friendly and cruelty-free too! Bold Expression: Your passport to fearless self-expression! Inside this handy kit, you'll find generous 2 fl oz bottles of Punky Colour Skin Protector and Punky Colour Stain Remover. This pack makes sure you have enough product to keep your skin in top condition no matter how crazy your hair colour sesh gets. Get your creative juices flowing like never before! Goodbye to Stains: Worry-free wild colour adventure! Get your colour game on with this Punky Colour Skin Protector Kit. It's so easy! Simply apply the Pre-Dye Skin Protector before colouring, this creates a barrier between your skin and dye. Once your colour session is complete, use the Post-Dye Stain Remover to effortlessly erase any lingering traces of colour on your skin. Rock your new vibrant hair with confidence knowing your skin remains healthy and glowing! How To Use: STEP 1 PRE-DYE SKIN PROTECTOR: Make sure area is dry before using. Apply generously around the hairline, ears and neck. Use to prevent any staining to the skin. Washes off with shampoo. STEP 2 POST-DYE STAIN REMOVER: Apply directly to cotton swab or ball. Gently massage stained area. Do not rub vigorously. If stain persists wash area with soap and water, blot dry and reapply Stain Remover. CAUTION: FOR EXTERNAL USE ONLY. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children. Do not apply to broken skin. Discontinue use if skin becomes red or if any allergic reaction occurs. PUNKY COLOUR

title: Poprock Purple | FOAMING HAIR COLOUR*
description: Introducing Punky Colour's Sugar Cloud, an innovative hair colour for effortless transformation. Their drip-free formula, infused with plant-based vegetable protein and ethically sourced sugar cane, delivers multi-benefit care. Hydrate, moisturise, and shine without the fuss – no mixing is needed. Simply shake, apply to dry hair, leave for 5 to 30 minutes, and embrace vibrant hair effortlessly.                                                                    Vegetable Protein:  Infused with vegetable protein, Punky's formula penetrates deep into the hair strands, working to repair and restructure from the inside out. Say goodbye to damage and hello to resilient, revitalised locks. Plant-Derived Moisture:  Providing both instant and profound hydration, their plant-derived moisture component ensures your scalp and hair receive the care they deserve. Revel in the benefits of deep nourishment, leaving your hair feeling soft, supple, and brilliantly moisturised. Sugar Cane: Ethically and responsibly sourced, their sugar cane ingredient not only aligns with your values but also delivers a range of skin benefits. Experience unparalleled shine and soothing agents that enhance the overall health and appearance of your hair. With Punky Colour's commitment to ethical sourcing, you can enjoy the transformation guilt-free How To Use: Apply to clean, dry hair making sure to section hair for easier application process. Always wear gloves. To avoid staining it's recommend using with their Stain Eraser Skin Protector Kit. Shake well before use. Pump directly into your hands and begin saturating hair, massaging the product into the areas you want to cover. Do not rub into scalp but saturate hair as thoroughly as possible to ensure total coverage. Rinse thoroughly with cool water. + Individual results may vary +More vibrant results are on bleached or pre-lightened hair + 2-3 Applications per bottle Ingredients: Water (Aqua, Eau), Pentylene Glycol, Decyl Glucoside, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, Saccharide Isomerate, Polyquaternium-44, Citric Acid, Fragrance (Parfum), Benzyl Alcohol, Dehydroacetic Acid, Basic Violet 2 (CI42520), HC Blue 15. WARNING: Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. CAUTION: This product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals. Perform a preliminary allergy test according to the directions printed on this carton 24 hours prior to application. Avoid contact with eyes. This product must not be used for dying eyelashes, eyebrows, mustache, beard or facial hair. To do so may cause blindness. Preliminary Allergy Test: Use soap and water to clean a small area of skin behind ear or on inner surface of forearm. Apply small quantity of colour to area and allow it to dry. Do not wash or cover spot. After 24 hours wash with mild soap and water. If no irritation or inflammation is apparent, it may be assumed that no hypersensitivity to the dye exists. Do not continue use if irritation occurs. If there is a reaction, DO NOT USE THE COLOUR. Consult a doctor. This test should be carried out before each application PUNKY COLOUR

description: Introducing Lethal's new Lip Stain – the perfect blend of vibrant colour and long-lasting wear! Black PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) involves a coating applied onto SS316L body jewellery. title: Scream: Ghost Face (Zombie Edition) 10" | DOLL
description: LDD Presents - Scream Ghostface (Zombie Edition) 10" Living Dead Doll "No, please don't kill me, Mr. Ghostface, I wanna be in the sequel!" What’s your favourite scary movie? The iconic slasher, who was inspired by Edvard Munch’s painting "The Scream", has been recreated as an adorable yet deadly Living Dead Doll, capturing the mysterious killer in his signature hooded robe and face mask, and wielding a hunting knife in his right hand in case you get any trivia questions wrong. The mysterious killer returns in his signature black hooded robe, swinging a hunting knife in his right hand, ready to strike fear into anyone and everyone. This Ghostface Zombie Edition features a brand-new head sculpt, showcasing a cracked ghost mask that adds an extra layer of terror.  The detailed doll stands approximately 10" tall and features 5 points of articulation for happy slashy posing options, and comes displayed in a die-cut window box. Relive the terror of the classic horror film with the Scream Ghostface (Zombie Edition) 10" Living Dead Doll in your collection. Size: Approx 10 Inches  Officially Licensed Product LIVING DEAD DOLLS

title: Tattoo Film | 2 PACK SACHET
description: The Ultimate Tattoo Protection Experience superior tattoo care with our Dr. Pickles Tattoo Film Sachets, each containing two pieces of Tattoo Film, sized at 14cm x 15cm. These sachets are packed with natural goodness, proudly Australian-made, and cruelty-free, making them the perfect choice for conscious tattoo enthusiasts. Please note that our Tattoo Film is designed to prevent infection, not to treat it. Directions for Use: 1. Initial Application : After your tattoo session, apply cling film or other Tattoo Film to wrap your fresh ink. Follow your artist's instructions, but we recommend removing the Tattoo Film when possible using warm water. Gently cleanse away blood and excess ink with Dr. Pickles Tattoo Foam Wash. 2. Drying: Pat your tattoo dry with clean paper towel and allow it to air dry until your skin begins to feel tight and dry. Allowing your tattoo to breathe like this after getting wet is crucial before it enters the peeling stage. 3. Sanitisation: Before touching your fresh tattoo or handling the Tattoo Film, sanitise your hands with Dr. Pickles Tattoo Foam Wash. 4. Application : Cut Film to size and apply to your tattoo while leaving at least a 1 cm gap between the tattoo's edge and the Tattoo Film. This helps the tattoo adhere to your skin. We recommend leaving Tattoo Film for the first 24 hours of the healing process before transitioning to the Wash and Heal tattoo care method. 5. Removal: To remove film, wash your fresh tattoo under warm water using Dr. Pickles Tattoo Foam Wash. Gently remove any excess ink, fluids, and blood under running water. Pat dry and allow it to air dry. Begin applying Dr Pickles Tattoo Balm or Dermal Soothe Gel after a further 24 hours of air drying.  **Caution:** Dr. Pickles Tattoo Film is thin and adhesive and we do not advise to leave it on your tattoo for more than two consecutive days. If reapplication is needed, follow the same procedure. DR PICKLES
